comments.author: Alrn
comments.body: The English name of this discovery is "The Colossus of Rhode's Pedestal's Past". The top section of legacy "Rhodes the Port City", leads you to new inland; the shore where the massive statue stands. Gives you 650x Sophia and Picture of the Colossus upon each enter.
